cards: The courtiers and the bureaucrats of the once noble estate are no more. But their treasures and valuables are still out there, corroding in the humidity of the swamp. Find them and bring them back, for we need them more than they do.
The first Loot Chest in each Objective Room contains a Valuable instead of the normal boon. Spawn only Rooms with loot as Objective Rooms.

We never used to venture into the swamp, for we were certain that nothing existed there. However, things have changed now and something vile festers there. Venture into the swamp and find out what's going on out there.

The water near the Hamlet has been contaminated and we've traced the source back to the swamp. We need you to go there, get some samples, and bring them here to study so that we find a way to reverse this before it is too late.

Objective Rooms are Rooms [court]2, [court]3 & [court]4. When you enter choose one at random and discard it when cleared. When in Area A [red-area] of these Rooms, a Hero must spend 2 actions to fill up a vial with blood. Rooms are cleared only if a vial is filled up.

The courtiers of the past rest out there, sleeping in their coffins. You should put an end to them, lest we allow them to walk on these grounds and bring an end to us sooner or later. Put them out of their misery and destroy their tombs. Hurry... before the day ends!
Clearing Curio Rooms causes Heroes to desecrate a tomb. Curios from these Rooms only ever have negative effects which cannot be countered by a Torch.
Deep in the night, the denizens of the Courtyard convene in unholy gatherings. Performing ill rituals of darkness and despair. Go there and end these gatherings. Slaughter them.

Decades ago, the Courtyard was built on top of a drained swamp; now the wilderness of the moor has returned to reclaim what men have taken from nature. Buildings are slowly sinking into the growing swamp, and Crocodilians once driven from their ancestral homes are recolonizing the overgrown gardens. Drive them away, lest more innocents become their prey.

More terrible insects and dangerous pests infest the once magnificent gardens. Their incessant buzzing reminds us of the danger lurking in the swamp. Go there and eradicate them swiftly. Make sure that none remain.

Even after so many years, the Courtyard remains a conundrum. Yet no single soul knows of how vast it is and the overgrowing foliage makes it ever so difficult. Go there and make a small map, so we can mount future expeditions in the future.
Decadent nobles, fallen to the darkness, are hosting nightmarish parties and galas, spreading sickness and sin alike. Crash their parties and put them to the blade, make sure that none survive.
Objective Rooms are Rooms [court]5, [court]6 & [court]7. When you enter choose one at random and discard it when cleared. Spawn only [court] Monsters in Objective Rooms.
The sickly nobility of the Courtyard has stolen heirlooms most dear and valuable. Take them back!

Courtyard Monsters in Objective Rooms have +7 Life. For the objective pieces, only draw from chests, as the first chest looted always grants a Level 2 Trinket card. Upon returning to the Hamlet, you can give any LvL 2 Trinkets to the Heir of your choice to gain the Xp (Maximum 3, and you lose those Trinkets). One Objective Room must be cleared as a minimum to do so.

The vampire court has convened yet again. Plotting and scheming against the hapless survivors of the Hamlet. Crash their decadent party, eradicate them all and keep the sickness away. Finish. Them. For. Good.
Objective Rooms are [court]6, [court]7, [court]8. Always spawn 2 Courtesans and 2 Chevaliers there.
Obscene monstrosities litter the Courtyard with their abominable presence. Eradicate them all. Bring peace to the once grandiose and serene garden, if even for a night.
Courtyard Monsters deal an additional [on-hit] 3[bleed] 3t and Self [heal]4 when they hit you.
The swamp - as vast as our miseries - remains a mystery to all of us. Scout the area ahead and track as much as you can. Otherwise we will not be able to mount any expeditions in the future.

Setup the Dungeon with random Rooms. Each time the party moves away from a cleared Room, replace the Room with a random Room Token (face-down). This Room is considered as though you haven't passed through it.

You must have heard of the Crocodilians. The dangerous animals that spread sickness and death along their path. They're preying in the swamp on the hapless Hamlet folk. Find their den and put their nests to the torch. Drive them away for good.
Objective Rooms are Rooms [court]4, [court]5 & [court]9. When entering, choose one at random and discard it when cleared. Always spawn 1 Crocodilian and 1 Adder there.

The courtiers of the past rest out there, sleeping in their coffins. You should put an end to them, lest we allow them to walk on these grounds and bring an end to us sooner or later. Put them out of their misery and destroy their tombs. Hurry... before the day ends!
Curio Rooms always have Battle. Clearing Curio Rooms causes Heroes to a tomb. Curios there have only negative effects that cannot be countered with a Torch.
